harDownload.label: HAR download
harDownload.description: Logs tab HAR button. Captures Pendo network requests for the validated page (Chrome/Edge: CDP plus a page reload; Firefox: partial capture from Resource Timing).

cspProbe.label: CSP probing
cspProbe.description: Active Content-Security-Policy probing against real response headers. Not implemented — the gate ships ahead of the feature so the work cannot reach users switched on. Needs CDP, so it stays off on Firefox even when enabled.

aiAdvice.label: AI remediation advice
aiAdvice.description: Settings card for choosing a provider and storing an API key, plus the provider request made when a validation run surfaces an issue.
